verdict.rationale: Moss is a real-time semantic search runtime (indexes, retrieval, SDKs, CLI, MCP server), and it has no concept of user-authored automations to version, review, or roll back, so this axis is a category error for this product type. Index snapshots and zero-downtime hot-swaps concern search data, not automations, and the 'agentic workflows' mentions refer to external frameworks like LangChain or the Vercel AI SDK, so none of this is credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
